2026-07-26 ~23:40Z — v0.20.9 execution round 1 results + local debris kill + two NEW findings.

USER VERDICTS (recorded): ship the full v0.20.9 → captain-hook 12.20.12 → local-retry chain; cut over cookiesync on home now; cc-pool re-auth parked until the user's signal; all three housekeeping items approved.

ROUND 1 (workflow wf_bad5bbe7): release lane BLOCKED correctly on an environmental test gate — root cause found by the orchestrator: ~14 orphaned Claude-CLI search-worker processes (proctitle "ugrep", image = claude 2.1.220 binary, PPID 1, ages 10h–25h, 50–90% CPU each) were holding local load at 85–110. All killed (SIGTERM-immune; SIGKILL via /bin/kill; evidence attached). Load collapsed 109 → <50 within minutes. The release worktree is fully prepped (CHANGELOG [0.20.9] + links done, build/lint/release-check green); the failing tests matched filed flake 243d40cc and reproduced on the BASE commit — diff exonerated. Workflow resumed to finish: test gate → commit → push → CI → signed tag → captain-hook 12.20.12 → local convergence retry.

NEW FINDING 1 — cookiesync 0.27.3 ships a BREAKING state schema with no migration (the 4th no-migration instance of the incident): expects the hostregistry envelope [schema host_registry cookie_sync]; 0.17.0-era state is flat {browsers, consent_route_hard, consent_route_to, row_baselines, self_target} — 7 tracked profiles + 1 baseline at stake. Compounding: brew cask upgrade PURGES the running version's Caskroom dir, hard-killing the resident helper (PID 1800 died at upgrade; crash-looped until bootout). Cutover lane resumed on the reposync-precedented lossless envelope migration (source-read → sandbox verify against the real 0.27.3 binary → gated apply → install). Binary rollback from brew cache remains the fallback. Bug filing in cookiesync's backlog + a bootout-first upgrade runbook note deferred until the lane releases the clone. Note: daemonkit's digest-staged programs make exactly this upgrade-kills-helper class impossible — the post-cutover era doesn't have it.

NEW FINDING 2 — codex-ask AND reposync cask binaries hang at _dyld_start on the LOCAL machine (zero output, rc=124 on any invocation; pre-dates today's upgrade). Ruled out by direct test: quarantine, signature/notarization (spctl accepts), amfid wedge (fresh-copy control runs), dylib set (identical to working ccx). Formula/other binaries (ccx, cc-notes, slop-cop) fine. codex-ask cask upgraded 1.8.2→1.8.4 regardless (was the queued upgrade); both versions hang. Candidate remedies: reboot (user consent), reinstall test, dtruss lane, route-around via the plugin path. Goes to the user in the wrap-up batch; formal investigation to file with placement TBD (cc-skills owns codex-ask; reposync equally affected).

HOUSEKEEPING DONE: brew prune freed 11.4 GB (df-confirmed; 962 removals, zero uninstalls, only stale keg ast-grep 0.44.1). v0.20.6 release object: lane correctly refused the note-f3a31f7f recipe (tag delete/re-push — forbidden); orchestrator authorized the tag-untouched Option B (manual gh release create with notes generated at the tag's own tree) carrying the user's housekeeping approval; v0.20.7 stays unpublished deliberately (burned tag, documented in CHANGELOG [0.20.8]).
